name: Apart Isabelle
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apart Isabelle is a holiday apartment in Ischgl, Tyrol. The accommodation is within walking distance of the Silvretta Cable Car and the town center. The apartment features a kitchenette, a bedroom, and a bathroom. A ski storage room and free Wi-Fi are provided. A parking space for a car is available. The accommodation is designed for two to four people. The furnishings are practical and functional. Guests will enjoy a peaceful location with a scenic mountain view.
